summary: Build practical workplace investigations and grievance mechanism skills with evidence, interviewing, safeguarding, and reporting exercises. Enquire today.
lede: Workplace investigations training prepares HR professionals, investigators and safeguarding teams to manage misconduct and grievance cases through a fair, documented process. Participants practise risk-based intake and conflict checks, evidence preservation, interview planning, and allegation-by-allegation findings. They also work on safeguarding escalation, case reporting, and proportionate management actions, with attention to confidentiality and procedural fairness.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who receive, oversee, investigate, advise on, or govern workplace misconduct and grievance cases. It suits mixed cohorts from corporate, nonprofit, public-service, and operational environments, with examples adapted to organisational maturity and applicable local labour laws.
modules: Evidence Handling and Digital Case Files
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to HR, employee relations, compliance, safeguarding, legal advice, occupational health and safety, or line management responsibilities. No legal qualification or programming experience is required. Bring a copy of your organisation's relevant grievance, whistleblowing, disciplinary, safeguarding, or investigation procedure if permitted by your information-security rules. The course uses anonymised materials and does not require disclosure of live cases.
